To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the time is now to promote place-based research into achieving global sustainability goals.

place-based social–environmental research can provide insights into global sustainability challenges, that its integration into global sustainability initiatives faces several challenges but also new opportunities are emerging.
place-based social– ecological research has the potential to contribute to global sustainability, and that its global integration is hampered by temporal, spatial and scale mismatches.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of whether and how place-based research can be integrated with global sustainability initiatives.

how place-based research can contribute to the achievement of global sustainability initiatives, how global sustainability initiatives can contribute to the advancement of place-based research and how both can benefit from the co-evolution of their research agendas.

how place-based social– ecological research can contribute to global sustainability initiatives and how global sustainability initiatives can benefit from it, and we identify opportunities to scale-up place-based research.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

place-based research can contribute to global sustainability initiatives by (1) providing a more comprehensive understanding of social–ecological systems and (2) providing local solutions to global challenges.

place-based research can contribute to global sustainability initiatives by providing a better understanding of the dynamics of social–ecological systems, by providing insights to trigger transformations, by providing a bridge between local initiatives and global sustainability initiatives and by providing a platform for the exchange of knowledge, experiences and tools to achieve sustainability goals.

place-based research can contribute to global sustainability by providing a deeper understanding of social–ecological systems and the co-construction and testing of local solutions, and by building a global community of researchers and practitioners to share and learn from each other, but that its integration at the global scale faces several challenges.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the global community of place-based research has a lot to offer in terms of knowledge, tools and capacity building to inform global sustainability initiatives.

place-based social– ecological research can inform global social–ecosystem sustainability by providing insights into the dynamics of local–global interconnections, the co-construction and co-creation of local solutions, and the role of regions as a bridge between global and local initiatives.
place-based social– ecological research is key to understand the dynamics of global change and the local solutions to tackle it.
The main takeaway from our work is that
place-based social– ecological research can provide a complementary lens to inform the global sustainability agenda.
place-based research is not just a tool to understand local social–ecological systems, but also a tool to inform global sustainability initiatives.
place-based research is a powerful tool to inform global sustainability initiatives, and that the global community can benefit from a better understanding of how to mainstream it.
